meta.scope_text: The list has 256 institutions in 32 countries. Included are holders of the Erasmus Charter for Higher Education (ECHE) where music is an independent degree-awarding institution (178) or the music unit of an arts university (24), and music units of general universities and universities of applied sciences whose parent holds the ECHE (54). For these units the coverage is based on the member list of the AEC (European Association of Conservatoires); Norway, Serbia and Sweden have also been gone through in full, so elsewhere units that are not AEC members may still be missing. Data retrieved 20 September 2026 from the European Commission's ECHE list. Institutions in the United Kingdom and Switzerland will be added once they have been awarded an ECHE (association with Erasmus+ from 1 January 2027).
meta.partner_source: Partner information is taken from the exchange-destination list published by the University of the Arts Helsinki.
